authorities.scope: Challenge brief and current evaluator contract
authorities.live_head_note: Counts and weights in release_contract supersede the older captured-vault totals; CFP-17/18 semantics match current public evaluator spec and EMB-15 is w3 per the delegated live contract.

CFP-17.criterion: An organizer can create a second event and both events coexist, each reachable through the event list or switcher.

CFP-18.criterion: Submissions, sessions, and speakers are event-scoped and do not leak into another event.

EMB-15.criterion: Organizer embed/share administration generates a snippet or share URL per widget with output formats, branding/colors, content filters, and field selection; manual proof covers different-origin live interactive rendering and offered JSON/XML/iCal outputs.

status_policy.not_started: No production behavior has been implemented for this item.
status_policy.in_progress: Work has started, but the complete persisted behavior and evidence contract is not yet present.
status_policy.implemented: The complete behavior exists and has a linked implementation record plus automated evidence, but applicable manual gates may remain.
status_policy.verified: Automated evidence passes and every applicable manual gate is verified.
status_policy.blocked_external: A named external dependency prevents progress and is linked through blocker; this is never treated as completion.
status_policy.area_rollups: rubric_areas.rollup_status is derived from rubric_item_tracking and is never edited independently.

CFP-18.implementation_record: server-side event-scoped module queries + run-scoped evaluator environment

manual_gates.gate: Real provider delivery IDs, rendered recipient snapshots and delivered/bounced/failed outcomes exist for confirmation, decisions, invitations, reminders and bulk sends.
Speaker invitation and attendee itinerary .ics artifacts parse independently and contain the expected identities, UIDs, sequence, status and times.
manual_gates.artifact: calendar parse report and sample artifacts

manual_gates.gate: A second reviewer cannot see author identity in a blind round or another reviewer's scores/comments before submitting.
Downloaded review export parses and contains expected rows, columns, values and statuses.
manual_gates.artifact: parser assertion report and export checksum

manual_gates.gate: Workers AI returns and persists a numeric score with written reasoning; a distinguishable organizer override persists after reload.
manual_gates.artifact: redacted provider/result record and override evidence

manual_gates.gate: Two provisioned speakers see only their own sessions, tasks, files and profile while direct organizer URLs remain blocked.
Real upload/download, immutable versions, comments, restoration, private denial and latest-version bulk ZIP all work with expected metadata.
manual_gates.artifact: object checksums, access-denial log and parsed ZIP manifest

manual_gates.gate: A configured styled embed renders live interactive data from a different origin, while JSON, XML and iCal outputs validate against approved event data.
manual_gates.artifact: external harness recording and output validation report

manual_gates.gate: The same approved session has identical canonical fields across organizer and all public surfaces and updates without re-embedding.
A live authorized one-way run records external IDs, item outcomes, redacted provider metadata and an idempotent retry of a controlled failure.
A live mapped Airtable run proves outward canonical sync and only allowlisted namespaced augmentation returns; conflicts and item outcomes are logged.
Golden-path state, anonymous itinerary selections and requirement-critical updates persist after full reload and role changes.
All five public surfaces are anonymous, approved-only, mobile-usable and sourced from the same live publication query.
Evidence manifest names CI commit SHA, migration version, deployment ID, public source URL, evaluation URL and requirement coverage.
The complete human contract is demonstrated through a coherent production-adapter golden path with no decorative or in-memory substitutes.
